entities.summary: Linda Zingerle is an Italian biathlete. She made her debut in the Biathlon World Cup in 2021. She is a two-time Youth Olympic Games medalist, a seven-time medalist at the Junior and Youth World Championships, and a two-time medalist at the senior European Biathlon Championships.
